entities.summary: Vice-Admiral Hans Birch Dahlerup was a Danish naval officer. He was among Denmark's most important naval strategists in the 19th century. Dahlerup rose through the ranks to become a counter admiral in the Royal Danish Navy. He also served as vice admiral and commander-in-chief of the Imperial Austrian Navy after the Revolution of 1848. Dahlerup rebuilt the Austrian navy and led the blockade and recapture of Venice in 1849. For these efforts, he was knighted by Franz Joseph I of Austria. Dahlerup had a broad interest in culture and science.
